C0182.title: High School Student Recruits Apprentices to Extort Merchants: "Professional Bad Review" Gang Operation
C0182.summary: Since 2019, Zhang, a student at a vocational college in Jiangxi, learned malicious claim techniques, then used edited images to fabricate product-quality problems and demand compensation from merchants while teaching extortion scripts and workflows to others. The “Dazhu Group” had more than 30 core members, recruited over 400 apprentices, charged RMB 588 to 1,288 as “apprenticeship fees,” and illegally earned more than RMB 300,000. Guangzhou Nansha police cracked the case in 2021, and many suspects were post-2000 students; merchants were forced to pay compensation.
